verdict.rationale: Channel3 is an agent-facing commerce API (catalog search, product lookup, buy URLs, and sale attribution), so asking about refund handling is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence contains nothing on initiating or tracking refunds, disputes, or order status for agent-placed orders. Sale recording for affiliate payouts and price-tracking webhooks are adjacent features and do not deliver this capability.

support.subject: As a developer, refunds on agent-placed orders can be initiated and tracked programmatically
